text:
Predicates:
Composer(x) ::: x is a composer.
MusicPiece(x) ::: x is a music piece.
Write(x, y) ::: x writes y.
Premiere(x, y) ::: x premieres y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Lead(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conclusion:
Write(beethoven, symphonyNo9) → Composer(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
Premises:
MusicPiece(symphonNo9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
∀x (Write(x, y) → Composer(x)) ::: Composers write music pieces.
Write(beethoven, symphonNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiere(viennaMusicSociety, symphonNo9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Lead(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
∀x (Orchestra(x) → ∃y (Conductor(y) ∧ Lead(y, x))) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
